items.q: Sarah Vaughan. © Fillius Jazz Archive -23- And she had Jimmy Jones playing piano, Roy Haynes playing and Richard Davis. So that’s that trio.

ctx.x: He was a bigot. An out and out bigot. He had him on the show and Lester was saying to Dick Cavett he says, “Wait a minute” he says, “I’m not prejudiced at all, not at all, I don’t see any difference between black and white.” So Dick says, “You’d better buy a pair of glasses because there’s a big difference between black and white.” I never looked at it as color. I wanted the best musicians in my band. Because where I lived on the east coast, I went out with the quartet I had was Terry Pollard for four years, I…

And she had Jimmy Jones playing piano, Roy Haynes playing and Richard Davis. So that’s that trio. Count Basie band with Joe Williams. Now this is one show. Count Basie and Joe Williams. Phineas Newborn’s trio. Bud Powell’s trio. Lester Young’s trio. Zoot Sims, Chet Baker’s group and Jeri Southern. That was one show. But then unfortunately Chet Baker’s band, they all got busted. After we were out about three days Jeri Southern got fired because she was half drunk all the time and soon had other commitments. So I…
